grammar_focus: 过去完成时(had + 过去分词:表示'过去的过去',比另一个过去动作更早)及其被动(had been + 过去分词),外加否定副词置于句首时的倒装(Not only had he... / Never had I... / Hardly had...);官方 Key structures 的冠词 a(n)/the 用法并入 gp5 作复习(原创承载 NCE3 L5 考点·编辑逼记者要确切数字,记者数台阶时被捕入狱)
scene: 美国杂志的编辑有时为了给读者确切的事实和数字,会走极端。去年,一家知名杂志派了一名记者出国,写一篇有关某遥远国家总统所住宏伟宫殿的报道。稿子寄到时,编辑读了第一句就拒绝发表。文章开头写道:“数百级台阶通向环绕宫殿的高墙。”编辑立刻给记者发传真,要他查清台阶的确切级数和墙的高度。记者动身去弄这些重要数字,可几周过去了,毫无回音。与此同时,杂志马上就要付印,编辑越来越不耐烦。他又发了三封传真,警告说若再不回,就解雇他。见还是没回音,编辑最终照原样发表了那篇文章。一周后,一封传真终于来了。这个可怜的记者不但被捕,还被投进了监狱。他只获准发出一条消息:他是在数那通向十五英尺高墙的1,084级台阶时被捕的。

grammar_card.title: “过去的过去”:过去完成时 & 它的被动 + 否定词倒装
grammar_card.intro: ①过去完成时 had + 过去分词——讲“比某个过去动作更早发生”的事,也叫“过去的过去”(When the article arrived 是过去;the magazine had sent a journalist 更早)。②被动就写成 had been + 过去分词(the poor man had been arrested 被捕;had been sent to prison 被关进监狱)。③否定副词/词组放句首(Not only、Never、Hardly、Seldom),后面要倒装——把 had/have/did 提到前面,像问句那样的语序(Not only had he been arrested… / Never had I seen…)。④本课官方还复习冠词:a(n) 泛指、the 特指。

rows: 比另一个过去动作更早发生
The magazine had sent a reporter before the article arrived.
过去完成被动 had been done
The man had been arrested and sent to prison.
Not only / Never / Hardly 放句首
Not only had he been arrested, but also thrown into prison.

specialRules.rule: 两个过去动作,先发生的那个用过去完成时 had done,后发生的用一般过去时(After he had counted the steps, he wrote down the number)。
Not only / Never / Hardly / Seldom 放句首,后面必须倒装:把 had/have/does/did 提到主语前面,像问句语序(Never had I seen…),这样用来加强语气。
美语里“传真”说 fax;“解雇”口语常说 fire(sb)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why did the editor first refuse to publish the article?
options: It gave no exact numbers or facts
It praised the president too much

passage: Editors of American magazines sometimes go to extremes to give their readers exact facts and statistics. Last year, a well-known magazine had sent one of its journalists abroad to write an article about the grand palace where a distant country's president lived. When the article arrived, the editor read the very first line and refused to publish it. The article began: 'Hundreds of steps lead up to the high wall that surrounds the palace.' At once the editor faxed the journalist and told him to find the exact number of steps and the height of the wall. The journalist set out to obtain these important facts, but weeks passed and no reply came. Meanwhile, the magazine was about to go to press, and the editor grew more and more impatient. He sent three more faxes, warning that the journalist would be fired if he did not answer soon. When no answer came, the editor finally published the article just as it had originally been written. A week later, a fax at last arrived. Not only had the poor journalist been arrested, but he had also been thrown into prison. He had been allowed to send only one message: he had been arrested while he was counting the 1,084 steps that led up to the fifteen-foot wall around the palace.

stage5.stem: "The magazine ___ a journalist abroad long before the article arrived."(比过去更早发生:过去完成时)
stage5.stem_cn: 早在稿子寄到之前,杂志就已派了一名记者出国。

stage5.stem: "When the editor read the first line, he knew the journalist ___ the wrong kind of article."(读之前就已写好,更早:过去完成时)
stage5.stem_cn: 编辑读第一句就知道记者写错了方向。

stage5.stem: "He explained that he ___ the palace steps before the police stopped him."(被拦之前先在数,更早:过去完成时)
stage5.stem_cn: 他解释说,警察拦住他之前,他正数着宫殿的台阶。

stage5.stem: "By June the editor still had not heard from the man, who ___ abroad back in April."(四月出国更早:过去完成时)
stage5.stem_cn: 到六月编辑还没收到那人的消息,他四月就出国了。

stage5.stem: "The editor finally published the article just as it ___ at first."(更早发生、且是“被写成”:过去完成被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 编辑最终照它起初被写成的原样发表了。

stage5.stem: "A week later they learned that the reporter ___ by the local police."(“被逮捕”、且更早:过去完成被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 一周后他们得知,记者已被当地警察逮捕。

stage5.stem: "The poor man ___ into prison before he could send any news."(“被投入监狱”、且更早:过去完成被动)
stage5.stem_cn: 还没来得及送出消息,这可怜人就已被投进监狱。

stage5.stem: "Not only ___ the poor journalist been arrested, but also thrown into prison."(Not only 放句首,引起倒装)
stage5.stem_cn: 这可怜的记者不但被捕,还被投进了监狱。

stage5.stem: "Never ___ I seen such a strange excuse until that day."(Never 放句首,引起倒装)
stage5.stem_cn: 直到那天,我才见过这么奇怪的借口。

stage5.stem: "Hardly ___ the editor published the article when the fax finally arrived."(Hardly 放句首,引起倒装)
stage5.stem_cn: 编辑刚发表文章,传真就终于到了。

stage5.stem: "The journalist ___ before the editor even arrived at the office."(先离开,发生更早:过去完成时)
stage5.stem_cn: 编辑还没到办公室,记者就已经走了。

stage5.stem: "After he ___ all the steps, he wrote down the exact number."(先数完,再写下:数用过去完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 他把所有台阶数完之后,写下了确切的数字。

stage5.stem: "The editor grew impatient and finally ___ the article himself."(叙事主线、后发生:一般过去)
stage5.stem_cn: 编辑不耐烦起来,最后自己把文章发表了。

stage5.stem: "The editor wanted to know ___ exact number of steps."(特指“那个唯一确定的数字”,用哪个冠词)
stage5.stem_cn: 编辑想知道那个确切的台阶数。

stage5.stem: "The journalist was writing ___ article about a famous palace."(泛指、单数可数、后面词以元音开头,用哪个冠词)
stage5.stem_cn: 记者正写一篇有关著名宫殿的报道。

stage5.stem: "A person who writes news reports for a magazine is a ___."(“记者”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 为杂志写新闻报道的人是记者。

stage5.stem: "The editor grew ___ because the journalist would not reply."(“不耐烦的”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 记者迟迟不回,编辑变得不耐烦。

stage5.stem: "The magazine printed the article just as it was ___ written."(“起初、原先”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 杂志照文章起初被写成的样子发表了。
